constraints: Bids only when confident about value
agents.name: Agent A

constraints: Limits bids to 30% above current price
agents.name: Agent B

agents.goal: Observe and learn from bidding patterns
agents.name: Agent C

causes.hypothesis: Aggressive bidding strategies lead to higher final auction prices
causes.name: Bidding strategy

causes.hypothesis: Higher starting prices lead to higher final auction prices
causes.name: Starting price

causes.hypothesis: Experienced bidders are more likely to outbid others
causes.name: Bidder experience

interaction.stopping_rule: Auction ends when all bidders have placed their final bid

outcome.measurement_question: What is the final price of the art piece after the auction concludes?
outcome.name: Final auction price
outcome.operationalization: The final price the art piece is sold for after all bidding rounds

scenario: 3 bidders participating in an auction for a piece of art starting at fifty dollars
